from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM

def load_kiln_dump(path):

def hf_forward_with_hidden(model, input_ids, output_hidden_states=True):

    if output_hidden_states:
        out = model(input_ids, output_hidden_states=True)
    else:
        out = model(input_ids)
    return out

def cos_sim(a, b):
    """Cosine similarity between two vectors."""
    a = a.flatten()
    b = b.flatten()
    return torch.dot(a, b) / (torch.norm(a) * torch.norm(b))

def max_delta(a, b):
    """Max absolute difference between two vectors."""
    return torch.abs(a - b).max().item()

def rel_err(a, b):
    """Relative error."""
    return torch.abs(a - b) / torch.abs(b)
